messages:
marie: Heads-up: eu-central GPU pool at 92% util, queue latency creeping >1.2s p50. Seeing admission bursts, some requests hitting token limits.

aj: saw it too — node evictions around 11:04 from kernel OOMs, autoscaler pending. logs: `evict pod gpu-node-11 (OOM)`

sasha: can we temporarily tighten admission? current TPM/RPM assumes 24 GPUs; we currently have 22 active.

kevin: math quick take: new_tpm = floor(available_gpus / nominal_gpus * configured_tpm) - safety_margin

kevin: e.g., floor(22/24 * 12000) - 200 => 10500 - 200 = 10300 TPM

marie: i'm going to push a conservative change: -15% TPM and bump queue slots from 50 -> 70 to favor latency over dropping tokens.

marie: patch:
```
admission:
  tpm_override: '-15%'
  max_queue_slots: 70
  token_smear: true
  smear_half_life_ms: 5000
```

aj: lgtm. also turning on regional fallback to eu-west1 for non-compliance workloads to shed load.

sasha: test command to simulate admit check (dev-only):
```
curl -s -H 'X-Debug: admit' https://router.internal/admit?model=gptx-small | jq
```

ops-bot: [11:12] node-reporter: gpu-node-11 marked NotReady -> evicted, replacement requested

kevin: monitor: watch `fleet.tokens.inflight`, `admission.queue.size`, and `router.shed_rate` dashboards.

marie: rolled change at 11:17, monitoring now. p50 latency dropping to 0.9s after 2m :thumbsup:

aj: autoscaler finished replacements at 11:31. Recommend reversing smear after healthy -> create follow-up

sasha: created ticket INFRA-4312 to compute automated tpm recalculation tied to node counts and kernel pressures.

marie: closing thread — will follow-up in INFRA-4312. Thanks!
